title: First arrivals: Positive-ink invoice
summary: Keep the first occurrence of each distinct reading, preserving encounter order. Return the sum of strictly positive values in the derived sequence, or 0 when none exist.
descriptionMd:
The reception stamp should acknowledge each visitor's tag only on its first arrival. Ada prepares an invoice that accepts only positive ink adjustments. Zero and negative derived readings stay off the invoice.

Keep the first occurrence of each distinct reading, preserving encounter order.

Return the sum of strictly positive values in the derived sequence, or 0 when none exist.

Implement firstArrivalsPositiveInkInvoice(readings, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
unitIntro: Set membership. Keep the first occurrence of each distinct reading, preserving encounter order. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.

Target time O(n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
hints: Start with set membership. What state describes the portion you have already processed?
Keep the first occurrence of each distinct reading, preserving encounter order. Derive each required reading once; do not restart the whole procedure for every output position.
Return the sum of strictly positive values in the derived sequence, or 0 when none exist. Handle the empty derived sequence according to the stated return rule.

cases.explanation: The derived sequence is [7,-3,0,12]. Return the sum of strictly positive values in the derived sequence, or 0 when none exist. This gives 19.
The derived sequence is [4,-2]. Return the sum of strictly positive values in the derived sequence, or 0 when none exist. This gives 4.
The derived sequence is []. Return the sum of strictly positive values in the derived sequence, or 0 when none exist. This gives 0.
